segments.sn22.17:1.3: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.17:1.4: Vedanā anattā … saññā anattā … saṅkhārā anattā … viññāṇaṃ anattā.
segments.sn22.17:1.8: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.17:1.9: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
